title: First-visit Thursday follow-up stays narrowed and speech-safe
description: The caller asks for the nearest first-consultation terms and then narrows the request to Thursday. The follow-up answer may come from a fresh lookup or from the slots already offered, but it should stay focused on Thursday, remain speech-safe, and ask which hour or term to choose next.
